{
  "opening_spine": {
    "pressure_source_type": "moral",
    "pressure_source": "Seren is abandoning the rehearsed wish mid-invocation, twisting the sacrifice toward Lirael’s unspoken wound instead of her own, and the presiding Dohkar is about to call her out in front of everyone",
    "hook_object": null,
    "opening_actor_id": "named:seren",
    "opening_beat": "Seren’s voice falters mid-sentence, her fingers tightening on the ceremonial sash she’s supposed to be holding steady—her earliest memory, the thing she cannot get back, now tangled with Lirael’s name",
    "rising_beats": [
      "Lirael’s muffled cry behind the mouthband goes unheard as the Dohkar’s gaze sharpens on Seren’s stumbling words",
      "Julian shifts at the edge of the gathering, the only one who hasn’t turned to watch the spectacle"
    ],
    "decision_beat": "Should she rip the mouthband off and speak the truth aloud—risking the rite’s collapse—or let Seren’s lie stand, and let the cost of it land on her instead?",
    "pc_career": "Sacrificiant",
    "opening_setting": "Veilwood ceremony clearing",
    "environment_element_ids": ["O1", "O4", "O5"],
    "environment_realizations": {
      "O4": "the mouthband is damp with sweat, the silk fraying at the knots where Lirael’s fingers have tugged at it twice already",
      "O5": "the sash’s embroidered vines are snagged on the spiralgrass, one thread loose where Seren’s grip has torn it"
    },
    "interlocutor_placement": "the presiding Dohkar — the senior officiant who has performed this rite a hundred times, his fingers already tracing the correction in the air before Seren finishes the wrong word",
    "pc_self_presentation_beat": "beat 1 — she adjusts the frayed mouthband with her teeth, the silk catching on her front tooth, and thinks *this is how it starts: with the things you can’t say*",
    "scene_want": "wants Seren to name the wound plainly, even if it breaks the rite, so she doesn’t have to carry the cost of the lie",
    "scene_mission": "Stop Seren from twisting the sacrifice before the Dohkar calls her out—and decide whether to let the truth come from her or take the blame herself",
    "reader_state": {
      "knows": "Seren is mid-sacrifice, the Dohkar is about to intervene, and Lirael’s mouth is bound so she can’t stop it",
      "believes": "the rite’s collapse will cost someone something they can’t name",
      "wondering": "what wound is Seren hiding—and why is Lirael the one who has to pay for it?",
      "must_not_confuse": "who is speaking, who is watching, and why the mouthband won’t let Lirael stop the lie"
    },
    "pc_body_callback": "beat 2 — stress_tic (the frayed mouthband)",
    "li_body_callback": "decision — focus_tell (Julian’s hands, still, at the edge of the gathering)",
    "staged_characters": [
      { "name": "Lirael", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_PC_OPENING_FUSION" },
      { "name": "Julian", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" },
      { "name": "Seren", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_OPENING_BEAT" },
      { "name": "the presiding Dohkar", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" }
    ]
  },
  "scene_skeleton": {
    "character_plus": [
      {
        "character": "Seren",
        "mode": "IN_PERSON",
        "option_id": "OPT-4",
        "expression_mode": "CONTRADICT",
        "first_mention": true,
        "visible_action": "Seren’s fingers tighten on the ceremonial sash, the embroidered vines snagging on the spiralgrass as she stumbles over the words, her voice softening the wound into something unnameable",
        "enacts_evidence_id": "E4",
        "behavior_object_ids": ["O5"],
        "behavior_person_ids": [],
        "revelation_bridge": "Her avoidance of naming the wound plainly reveals she believes softening it is kinder than making it endure direct recognition—even when it costs someone else.",
        "pc_lens_operation": "INWARD_TRANSLATION_OF_ANOTHER_PERSONS_COST",
        "pc_interpretation": "Seren believes sparing Lirael the truth is mercy, even if it means Lirael carries the weight of the lie."
      },
      {
        "character": "the presiding Dohkar",
        "mode": "IN_PERSON",
        "option_id": "OPT-8",
        "expression_mode": "CONTROL",
        "first_mention": true,
        "visible_action": "The Dohkar’s fingers trace the correction in the air before Seren finishes the wrong word, his gaze locking onto her stumble as if the misalignment were already his to fix.",
        "enacts_evidence_id": "E6",
        "behavior_object_ids": [],
        "behavior_person_ids": ["named:seren"],
        "revelation_bridge": "His assumption that his judgment carries authority reveals he treats sacrifice as something he alone can judge correctly—even when the cost is someone else’s.",
        "pc_lens_operation": "EMOTIONAL_CONCLUSION_BEFORE_EVIDENCE",
        "pc_interpretation": "The Dohkar believes his authority overrules Seren’s hesitation, and that the rite’s rules are his alone to enforce."
      }
    ],
    "environment_plus": {
      "target_object_id": "O4",
      "axis": "damage",
      "beat": "the mouthband is frayed at the knots where Lirael’s fingers have tugged at it twice already, the silk catching on her front tooth every time she adjusts it"
    },
    "pc_opening_fusion": {
      "character": "Lirael",
      "placement": "PC_FIRST_EMBODIED_BEAT",
      "character_angle": "her body reacts to Seren’s stumble before her mind catches up—her fingers twitch toward the mouthband, already deciding whether to rip it off or let the lie stand",
      "beat": "Lirael’s muffled cry behind the mouthband goes unheard as the Dohkar’s gaze sharpens on Seren’s stumbling words, her own breath hitching in her throat like a warning"
    }
  }
}
